name: demo
description: A populated installation for screenshots and evaluation: a site with a navigation-shaped set of pages across every status, plus accounts at three privilege levels. Deterministic — the same file produces the same world on every load, which is what makes a screenshot comparable to the last one.
statements: insert into sites (id, organization_id, key, name, status, theme) select gen_random_uuid(), anchor.organization_id, 'demo', 'Demo site', 'active', 'default' from (select id as organization_id from organizations order by created_at desc limit 1) anchor where not exists (select 1 from sites s where s.organization_id = anchor.organization_id and s.key = 'demo')

insert into pages (site_id, slug, page_type, status) select s.id, 'home', 'page', 'published' from sites s where s.key = 'demo' and not exists (select 1 from pages p where p.site_id = s.id and p.slug = 'home')
